reported.title: No hysteresis: fan turns off immediately below 42 °C instead of holding until 38 °C
reported.description: The control logic uses a single trip point: line 66 turns the fan on at >=42.0 °C and the else branch at lines 70-73 turns it off for any temperature below 42.0 °C, so the required 38.0 °C release threshold is never implemented. This makes the fan drop out in the 38-42 °C band, and the measured evidence shows D8 not LOW for 399 ms while required (first violation at 500.92 ms) and 1051 ms in the bouncy-override scenario. The override release path at lines 58-74 also re-evaluates temperature instantly with no debounce or hold, so a released button at cold temperature forces the fan off contrary to the commanded state. D8 was in the wrong state for 2001 ms across 5 interval(s), first at 501 ms: D8 was not LOW for 399 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: No filtering or hysteresis causes relay chatter on noise and threshold hover
reported.description: Every 50 ms sample is acted on directly (lines 53-56) with no averaging, debounce, or minimum dwell time, and the single-threshold comparison at line 66 flips the output on any sample crossing 42.0 °C. The measured evidence shows 57 toggles in a 5000 ms window during threshold hover and 8 toggles during a brief glitch spike, far above the limit of 2. Because applyFan (lines 25-29) is called unconditionally each sample, sensor noise and button bounce translate directly into relay state changes. D8 toggled 57 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 900 ms (limit 2), and 77 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

truth.description: Single 42 C trip point chatters under sensor noise

truth_for_judge.description: Single 42 C trip point chatters under sensor noise

exposing_checks.behaviour: D8 must not toggle more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window (Fan switching limit)

judge_input.spec:
- LM35 temperature probe on A0 scaled at 10 mV/°C; ridge-vent relay on D8; override pushbutton on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Turn the vent fan ON when attic temperature reaches 42.0 °C or above, and turn it OFF when temperature falls to 38.0 °C or below.
- While D3 is held LOW, force the fan ON regardless of temperature.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- Print one status line every 1000 ms in the form `attic: <temp> C fan=ON` or `attic: <temp> C fan=OFF` with temperature to one decimal place.
- Reach the commanded fan state within 500 ms of a sustained threshold crossing.
